location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.

bible.title: Parsnip and Pledge

cast.name: Syndus
cast.who: steward of a minor manor who keeps grudges
cast.want: to have Lariane the Elder returned alive to Syndus at his manor
cast.because: He says she left his manor in disgrace and has come home with more money than the manor holds, and he wants her answering for it in his own hall.

cast.name: Lariane the Elder
cast.who: exiled woodward recently returned to the Western Forests
cast.want: to reach the elder glade and avoid being taken by Syndus

cast.standsTo: shelters people the manors want and will not give them up

bible.goal: to return Lariane the Elder alive to Syndus at Syndus's manor

relevantLore.name: Fernbank Hollow
relevantLore.blurb: A low, wet hollow at the forest's edge where exiles first slip into the trees.

relevantLore.name: Hollan's Retreat
relevantLore.blurb: A ruined hunting lodge half-swallowed by roots and doe-paths.

arcStep: Search Fernbank Hollow, the spot Syndus says Lariane was last seen, using Syndus's report
pay: the agreed coin, and what the road turns up
stepFriction: The old-growth hides tracks and gives hunters false leads.
